tools.name: CreateInclude
tools.description: Create a new ABAP Include program (Type I, PROG/I) in SAP system. Creates the include object and registers it under the main program in D010INC. By default also auto-inserts an `INCLUDE <name>.` statement into the main program source so the include is actually used. Use UpdateInclude to set source code afterwards. Unlike CreateProgram with program_type=include (which creates PROG/P), this creates a proper PROG/I include. For mass-activation scenarios (many cross-referencing includes) pass source_code inline, set activate_main_program=false and skip_program_tree_check=true, then call ActivateObjects once with the full set.

include_name.description: Include program name (e.g., ZPAEK_TEST_INC01). Must follow SAP naming conventions (start with Z or Y).

main_program.description: Name of the main/master program that will contain this include (e.g., ZPAEK_TEST003). Required for proper include registration and activation.

description.description: Include description (max 60 chars). If not provided, include_name will be used.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LAB, $TMP for local objects).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (e.g., DEVK905123). Required for transportable packages. Optional for local ($TMP) objects.

insert_into_main.description: Auto-insert `INCLUDE <name>.` statement into the main program source. Default: true. Set false to skip main-program modification.

source_code.description: Optional include body. When provided, the handler also locks, writes the source, and unlocks the new include in a single call. Never activates — caller must run a separate activation (ActivateObjects for batch scenarios).

activate_main_program.description: When inserting INCLUDE statement into the main program, also activate the main program afterwards. Default: true (existing behavior). Set false when batching many includes so that activation is deferred to a single ActivateObjects call.

skip_program_tree_check.description: Skip the post-create program-tree syntax check. Default: false (existing behavior). Set true when batching many cross-referencing includes — an intermediate include in a cycle will necessarily fail the tree check while its siblings are still missing.

tools.name: GetEnhancementImpl
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific enhancement implementation by its name and enhancement spot.

tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve a list of enhancements for a given ABAP object.

tools.name: GetEnhancementSpot

tools.name: GetFunctionGroup
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP function group definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetFunctionModule
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP function module definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

function_group_name.description: FunctionGroup name containing the function module (e.g., Z_MY_FUNCTIONGROUP).

tools.name: GetGuiStatus
tools.description: Get ABAP GUI Status definition including statuses, function codes, menus, toolbars, and titles. A large program interface is big: pass status_name and/or function_codes to narrow every table, and format="compact" for one line per function (code, text, icon, function key, toolbar).

status_name.description: Optional: one GUI Status name. Narrows every table to that status (its SET functions, FUN texts, PFK keys, BUT toolbar, ACT / MEN / MTX menus); TIT / DOC / BIV are left out. If omitted, returns all statuses.

function_codes.description: Optional: function codes to keep (e.g. ["SAVE", "CRPO"]). Narrows FUN / SET / PFK / BUT to them.

format.description: full (default) = CUA tables; compact = { statuses: [{ code, type, functions: [{ code, text, icon?, fkey?, toolbar? }] }] }.

tools.name: GetGuiStatusList
tools.description: [read-only] List all GUI statuses belonging to an ABAP program.

tools.name: GetInactiveObjects
tools.description: [read-only] Get a list of inactive ABAP objects — modified but not yet activated, pending activation. Shows classes, tables, CDS views, and other objects awaiting activation.

tools.name: GetInclude
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve source code of a specific ABAP include file.

tools.name: GetIncludesList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively discover and list ALL include files within an ABAP program or include.

object_name.description: Name of the ABAP program or include

object_type.description: ADT object type (e.g. PROG/P, PROG/I, FUGR, CLAS/OC)

detailed.description: If true, returns structured JSON with metadata and raw XML.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms for each ADT request.

tools.name: GetInterface
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP interface definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

output.description: "inline" (default) or "file": writes the source under the MCP output dir and returns path, line count and an outline with line ranges. Prefer "file" for large objects.

tools.name: GetJobUsage
tools.description: [read-only] Check whether programs are used as background job steps (SM37 jobs, TBTCO/TBTCP): true when the program is a step of a job that is scheduled now (released/ready/active, incl. periodic) or that finished/was cancelled in the last N months. SE38/SA38 dialog runs do not count. `oldest` = start date of the oldest finished job still kept; job reorganization deletes older ones, so when `complete` is false a false means "no job since <oldest>". No user names are returned. ECC-only (ZMCP_WL_JOB_USAGE bridge FM).

months.description: Months back including the current one (1-36). Default: 12.

tools.name: GetLocalDefinitions
tools.description: Retrieve local definitions source code from a class (definitions include). Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetLocalMacros
tools.description: Retrieve local macros source code from a class (macros include). Supports reading active or inactive version. Note: Macros are supported in older ABAP versions but not in newer ones.

tools.name: GetLocalTestClass

tools.name: GetLocalTypes

tools.name: GetMetadataExtension

tools.name: GetNodeStructureLow
tools.description: [low-level] Fetch node structure from ADT repository. Used for object tree navigation and structure discovery. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

tools.name: GetObjectInfo

Shows root, group nodes, and terminal leaves up to maxDepth. Enrich each node with description and package via SearchObject if enrich=true.

maxDepth.description: Maximum tree depth (default depends on type)

tools.name: GetObjectNodeFromCache

tools.description: [read-only] Retrieves all ABAP objects of a specific type (classes, tables, programs, interfaces, etc.) under a given parent node. Useful for listing all objects of one type within a package or composite object.

tools.name: GetObjectsList
tools.description: [read-only] Recursively retrieves all child ABAP repository objects for a given parent — programs (PROG), function groups (FUGR), classes (CLAS), packages (DEVC), and other composite objects — including nested includes and subcomponents.

tools.name: GetObjectStructure
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ADT object structure as a compact JSON tree.

tools.name: GetObjectStructureLow
tools.description: [low-level] Retrieve ADT object structure as compact JSON tree. Returns XML response with object structure tree. Can use session_id and session_state from GetSession to maintain the same session.

object_type.description: Object type (e.g., "CLAS/OC", "PROG/P", "DEVC/K", "DDLS/DF")

session_id.description: Session ID from GetSession. If not provided, a new session will be created.

session_state.description: Session state from GetSession (cookies, csrf_token, cookie_store). Required if session_id is provided.

tools.name: GetPackage

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., Z_MY_PACKAGE).

tools.name: GetPackageContents

tools.name: GetPackageTree
tools.description: [high-level] Retrieve complete package tree structure including subpackages and objects. Returns hierarchical tree with object names, types, and descriptions.

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., "ZMY_PACKAGE")

include_subpackages.description: Include subpackages recursively in the tree. If false, subpackages are shown as first-level objects but not recursively expanded. Default: true

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for recursive package traversal. Default: 5

tools.name: GetProgFullCode

output.description: "inline" (default) or "file": writes the source under the MCP output dir and returns path, line count and an outline with line ranges. Prefer "file" for large objects.

tools.name: GetProgram
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP program definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetScreensList

tools.name: GetServiceBinding

tools.name: GetSession
tools.description: [read-only] Get a new session ID and current session state (cookies, CSRF token) for reuse across multiple ADT operations. Use this to maintain the same session and lock handle across multiple requests.

force_new.description: Force creation of a new session even if one exists. Default: false

tools.name: GetSmartFormContent
tools.description: [read-only] Read what a SmartForm prints, for a preview: per page and window (position in mm) the content tree — text nodes with their lines (paragraph format + text with inline tags and &symbols&), include texts, tables / templates / loops with line types and cells, graphics, addresses, conditions; code nodes appear only as markers (no program lines). Also fetches the SmartStyles as CSS, the SE78 graphics with a fixed key as BMP files (with printed size) and the include texts with a fixed key. Graphics / texts whose key holds a &symbol& are listed under dynamicReferences. Active version, texts in the logon language. Files go under the MCP output directory (smartforms/<form>/), including <form>.content.json with the full result; summary=true answers with an overview (windows, data declarations, &symbols&, files) instead of the content tree. Needs the ZMCP_SSF_CONTENT FM and the SSF_CONTENT dispatcher action.

include_graphics.description: Fetch SE78 graphics with a fixed key as BMP files. Default true.

include_styles.description: Fetch the SmartStyles (form default + text node styles) as CSS. Default true.

include_texts.description: Fetch include texts (SO10) with a fixed key. Default true.

summary.description: Answer with an overview (windows, data declarations, &symbols&, graphics, files) instead of the full content tree; the full result is always written to files.content. Default false.

values.description: Sample values for &symbols& in graphic keys (e.g. {"IM_SIGN": "ZSIGN"}): graphics named by a variable are then fetched too.

device.description: Output device whose printer fonts the preview should assume. Default: a device whose type has fonts for most of the families of the form.

text_language.description: Language for include texts whose key has no language: 1-char SAP key (e.g. "3") or 2-letter ISO code (e.g. "KO"). Default: the form language.

tools.name: GetSmartFormLayout
tools.description: [read-only] Read the page and window layout of a SmartForm (active version; a never-activated form is read from its saved version, then `active` is false): per page the format, orientation, next page, CPI / LPI and style, and per window its type (MAIN / SECONDARY / ...), position and size as stored (value + unit) and converted to millimetres. Layout only: no texts, code or form interface. Needs the ZMCP_SSF_LAYOUT FM and the SSF_LAYOUT dispatcher action.

language.description: Form language: 1-char SAP key (e.g. "E", "3") or 2-letter ISO code (e.g. "EN", "KO"). Default: the master language of the form.

tools.name: GetSqlQuery
tools.description: [read-only] Execute ABAP SQL SELECT queries on database tables and CDS views via SAP ADT Data Preview API. Use for ad-hoc data retrieval, row counts, and filtered queries.

row_number.description: Maximum number of rows to return

acknowledge_risk.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has explicitly authorized row extraction from an 'ask'-tier protected table. The approval is logged to stderr for audit. Has no effect on 'deny'-tier tables.

tools.name: GetStructure
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP structure definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetTable
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP table definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetTableContents
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve contents (data preview) of an ABAP database table or CDS view, like SE16. Compact by default: column names only, empty cell values left out of each row, 20 rows. Use fields to keep only some columns and include_metadata for column types/descriptions.

tools.name: GetTcodeUsage
tools.description: [read-only] Check whether transactions were used in the last N months, from the ST03N workload monthly aggregates. Returns one boolean per transaction plus `coverage` = months that actually hold workload data; when coverage < months, false means "not used in the last <coverage> months". No user names are returned. ECC-only (ZMCP_WL_TCODE_USAGE bridge FM).

months.description: Months back including the current one (1-36). Default: 12.

destination.description: SM59 RFC destination (on the connected system) of the system to measure, e.g. the QA or PRD system. Omitted → SAP_USAGE_RFCDEST from the profile sap.env, else the connected system. "" or "LOCAL" → the connected system.

tools.name: GetTextElement
tools.description: Read ABAP program text pool (text symbols, selection texts, title, headings). Optionally filter by text_type / key.

language.description: Language key (1-char, e.g., "E", "D", "K"). Defaults to the SAP logon language.

text_type.description: Filter by ID: "I"=text symbol, "S"=selection text, "R"=program title, "H"=list heading.

key.description: Optional: filter by row key (e.g., "001" for text symbol TEXT-001, or a parameter name for selection text).

tools.name: GetTransaction
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transaction (t-code) details from TSTC / TSTCP — program, screen, and kind (program, parameter transaction with its target t-code and parameters such as an SM30 view, variant transaction). Pass transaction_names for many t-codes in one call.

tools.name: GetTransport
tools.description: [read-only] Retrieve ABAP transport request information including metadata, included objects, and status from SAP system.

owner.description: SAP user who owns the transport. On ECC the session-user-scoped path endpoint silently filters out other users' TRs — pass `owner` to retry via the list endpoint. On S/4 usually unnecessary, but provide it if the path read is rejected by authorization.

include_objects.description: Include list of objects in transport (default: true)

include_tasks.description: Include list of tasks in transport (default: true)

tools.name: GetTypeInfo

include_structure_fallback.description: When true (default), tries DDIC structure lookup only if type lookup returns 404/empty.

tools.name: GetUnitTest
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run status and result for a previously started run_id.

tools.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run result for a run_id.

with_navigation_uris.description: Include navigation URIs in result if supported.

tools.description: Retrieve ABAP Unit test run status for a run_id.

run_id.description: Run identifier returned by unit test run.

with_long_polling.description: Enable long polling while waiting for status.

tools.name: GetUsageSnippets
tools.description: [read-only] Line-level where-used hits: for each referencing object, the source lines that use the searched object, with uri ".../source/main#start=<line>,<col>", line, column and the source line. Pass object_identifiers from GetWhereUsed references[].object_identifier, or object_name + object_type to run the where-used search first (customer_only / package filters apply to that search). Works on ECC 7.40 and S/4HANA.

object_identifiers.description: object_identifier values from GetWhereUsed references[]. Takes precedence over object_name / object_type.

object_name.description: Object to search (used when object_identifiers is not given).

object_type.description: Object type for object_name: class, interface, program, include, functiongroup, function_module, table, structure, dataelement, domain, view, tabletype (ECC), transaction (ECC), messageclass (ECC), package

customer_only.description: With object_name: only customer referencing objects (Z / Y name, or package Z* / Y* / $*). Default: false.

package.description: With object_name: package filter on the referencing objects (exact, or prefix with trailing *).

max_objects.description: Cap on referencing objects whose snippets are fetched. Default: 200. truncated=true when more were available.

include_context.description: Include the multi-line context SAP returns per hit (description). Default: false.

timeout_ms.description: Optional request timeout in ms per SAP request (the where-used search and each snippet batch).

tools.name: GetCdsView
tools.description: Retrieve ABAP view definition. Supports reading active or inactive version.

tools.name: GetVirtualFoldersLow
tools.description: [low-level] Retrieve hierarchical virtual folder contents from ADT information system. Used for browsing ABAP objects by package, group, type, etc.

preselection.description: Optional preselection filters (facet-value pairs for filtering)

values.description: Array of facet values to filter by

facet_order.description: Order of facets in response (e.g., ["package", "type"]). Default: ["package", "type"]

tools.name: GetWhereUsed
tools.description: [read-only] Find where-used references (cross-references, usages, dependencies) for ABAP objects — classes, interfaces, tables, data elements, programs, function modules, etc. Returns list of all referencing objects with their types and packages. On ECC a function module may be given by plain name (no GROUP|FM needed). Widely used SAP standard tables (e.g. VBAK) can take about 60 s and return thousands of references — use customer_only / package / max_results to shrink the answer (filtering happens after the SAP search, so it does not shorten the search time). Pass references[].object_identifier to GetUsageSnippets for line-level hits.

object_type.description: Type of the ABAP object: class, interface, program, include, functiongroup, function_module, table, structure, dataelement, domain, view, tabletype (ECC), transaction (ECC), messageclass (ECC), package

enable_all_types.description: If true, searches in all available object types (Eclipse 'select all' behavior). Default: false (uses SAP default scope). Ignored on ECC (no scope resource).

max_results.description: Optional cap on references[] after filtering. Omit or 0 = no cap. truncated=true when more were found.

customer_only.description: Optional. Keep only customer objects: name starting with Z / Y, or package Z* / Y* / $*. Objects in /namespace/ (SAP industry solutions, partners, generated /1.../) are dropped; for a registered customer namespace use package: "/ACME/*" instead. Default: false.

package.description: Optional package filter on references[].package_name: exact name, or prefix with a trailing * (e.g. ZSD*).

timeout_ms.description: Optional request timeout in ms for the SAP search. Default: SAP_TIMEOUT_LONG (120 s) on ECC, SAP_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT (45 s) otherwise.

tools.name: PatchGuiStatus
tools.description:
Row-level merge into an existing ABAP GUI Status definition. Fetches current CUA → merges the caller-supplied changes (by natural key) → writes merged result back. Rows / fields you omit are preserved. Safer default for targeted edits; use UpdateGuiStatus only when you truly want to replace the whole CUA.

Merge keys per table:
  STA=CODE, FUN=CODE, PFK=CODE+PFNO, BUT=PFK_CODE+CODE+NO, TIT=CODE,
  MEN=CODE+NO, MTX=CODE, ACT=CODE+NO, SET=STATUS+FUNCTION,
  DOC=OBJ_TYPE+OBJ_CODE, BIV=CODE+POS.

changes.description: Partial CUA data to merge into the current definition. Same shape as cua_data (ADM / STA / FUN / MEN / MTX / ACT / BUT / PFK / SET / DOC / TIT / BIV). Accepts JSON string or object. Rows matched by natural key are field-merged (changes win). New rows are appended. Omitted tables are left untouched.

transport_request.description: Transport request number.

activate.description: Activate after patch. Default: false.

skip_validation.description: Skip client-side validation of the merged result. Default: false.

tools.name: UpdateDataElement
tools.description:
Update an existing ABAP data element in SAP system.

Workflow:
1. Gets domain info (if type_kind is 'domain') to extract dataType/length/decimals
2. Acquires lock on the data element
3. Updates data element with provided parameters (complete replacement)
4. Unlocks data element
5. Optionally activates data element (default: true)
6. Returns updated data element details

Supported type_kind values:
- domain: Based on ABAP domain (requires type_name = domain name)
- predefinedAbapType: Direct ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToPredefinedAbapType: Reference to ABAP type (requires data_type, length, decimals)
- refToDictionaryType: Reference to another data element (requires type_name = data element name)
- refToClifType: Reference to class (requires type_name = class name)

Note: All provided parameters completely replace existing values. Field labels are truncated to max lengths (10/20/40/55).

package_name.description: Package name (e.g., ZOK_LOCAL, $TMP for local objects)

transport_request.description: Transport request. Required for transportable packages.

type_kind.description: Type kind: domain, predefinedAbapType, refToPredefinedAbapType, refToDictionaryType, refToClifType

type_name.description: Type name: domain name, data element name, or class name (depending on type_kind)

data_type.description: Data type (CHAR, NUMC, etc.) - for predefinedAbapType or refToPredefinedAbapType

activate.description: Activate data element after update (default: true)

Use this to modify existing programs without re-creating metadata. Alternatively pass source_file (local path, read server-side) or patch (old/new hunks applied to the active source).

program_name.description: Program name (e.g., Z_TEST_PROGRAM_001). Program must already exist.

transport_request.description: Transport request. Required for transportable packages.

activate.description: Activate program after source update. Default: false. Set to true to activate immediately, or use ActivateObject for batch activation.

source_file.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 file read by the gateway. Alternative to source_code — pass exactly one of source_code / source_file. Use it for large sources instead of inlining 100 KB of escaped JSON.

patch.description: Server-side replacements applied to the ACTIVE source, so the unchanged lines never travel. Each hunk must match expected_count times (default 1) or nothing is written (CONTENT_MISMATCH).

expected_count.description: How many occurrences must exist. Default 1.

expected_line_count.description: Integrity check: abort with CONTENT_MISMATCH (nothing written) when the payload line count differs from this value.

expected_sha256.description: Integrity check: abort with CONTENT_MISMATCH (nothing written) when sha256(payload) differs from this hex digest.

check_no_change.description: Read the active version first and answer no_change=true (no lock, no write) when it already equals the payload. Default false: the write happens as before.

tools.name: UpdateTable
tools.description: Update DDL source code of an existing ABAP table. Locks the table, uploads new DDL source, and unlocks. Optionally activates after update. Use this to modify existing tables without re-creating metadata.

table_name.description: Table name (e.g., ZZ_TEST_TABLE_001). Table must already exist.

ddl_code.description: Complete DDL source code for a TRANSPARENT TABLE. IMPORTANT — use the MANDT data element for the client key ('key mandt : mandt not null'), NOT 'abap.clnt' (that's CDS-view syntax). Standard SAP tables (MARA, T001, VBAK, …) all use MANDT. The annotation block CreateTable seeded must be preserved verbatim: #NOT_EXTENSIBLE enhancement category, #TRANSPARENT tableCategory, #A deliveryClass, #RESTRICTED dataMaintenance. Example: '@EndUserText.label : \'My Table\' @AbapCatalog.enhancement.category : #NOT_EXTENSIBLE @AbapCatalog.tableCategory : #TRANSPARENT @AbapCatalog.deliveryClass : #A @AbapCatalog.dataMaintenance : #RESTRICTED define table ztst_table { key mandt : mandt not null; key id : abap.char(10); name : abap.char(255); }'

activate.description: Activate table after source update. Default: true.

tools.name: WriteTextElementsBulk
tools.description: Register many ABAP text elements (R/I/S/H) in ONE tool call via a single TPOOL RFC write. Use instead of calling CreateTextElement N times. With activate=false (default) the pool is staged INACTIVE — the parent program's next activation promotes every entry atomically, which is the correct flow for "register 40 now, activate program later". With activate=true the pool is written ACTIVE immediately. Set replace_existing=false to merge into the current pool instead of replacing it.

language.description: 1-char language key (e.g. "K" for Korean). Defaults to SAP logon language.

text_elements.description: Array of entries. Each: { type: "R"|"I"|"S"|"H", key?: string, text: string }. R ignores key (single-row program title — key defaults to program name). I requires a 3-char key. S requires a parameter / select-option name (max 8 chars). H requires one of "listHeader" or "columnHeader_N".

replace_existing.description: If true (default), the TPOOL is replaced with the provided entries only. If false, existing rows are preserved and provided rows merge by (type, key).

transport_request.description: Transport request number (informational).

activate.description: false (default) — stage as INACTIVE (program activation promotes). true — write ACTIVE immediately.
